text:
jamie: Speed-recs: one sentence to make someone try it this week. no explanations, no spoilers, go.
sana: Book: "The Night Watch"
- one sentence: like a midnight city with secrets in the gutters. :books: :crescent_moon: 
leo: Movie: "Paris, Texas"
- one sentence: road-movie quiet that will make you notice deserts again. :oncoming_automobile: :desert_island: 
grace: Album: Swans
- one sentence: enormous, slow-building waves that leave your ribcage rearranged. :musical_note: :ocean: 
omar: TV: "Better Call Saul"
- one sentence: a crime show that doubles as a masterclass in regret and small, crushing choices. :clapper: :broken_heart: 
jamie: Game: "Return of the Obra Dinn"
- one sentence: detective fiction with a brain made of ink and math. :joystick: :magnifying_glass: 
sana: Quick poll: react with :fire: if you'll try any of these this week, :zzz: if not.
hippo-bot: Reminder: weekly social at 17:00 Friday in the kitchen. (Not a rec but relevant.) :hippo:
leo: Bonus tiny rec line: short story "St. Lucy's Home for Girls Raised by Wolves"
- one sentence: tender, weird, and sharper than it looks. :wolf: :sparkles: 
grace: also adding a 6-song bedtime tape: https://tinyurl.com/bedtime-tape-6 (lo-fi, <40 mins)
omar: If anyone wants a spreadsheet of these one-liners for later, ping me and I'll dump it.
jamie: Love the variety. screenshotting for later. :camera_with_flash:
